_readme: This is a DRAFT execution-preparation artifact, not a scoring_stage_approval.
It is not consumed by raptor.eval.prospective_freeze.validate_scoring_stage_approval,
is not wired into any loader, and its 'schema' value is deliberately NOT
'raptor.eval.scoring_stage_approval.v1', so it can never be mistaken for,
or accidentally accepted as, a real approval record even if a future
caller pointed at this file by mistake.
This gates ADR-0020 stage 4 (4_MASK_AND_LABEL_FREE_SCORE) ONLY -- BIAS/
Nirvana execution and label-dependent evaluation. It is a SEPARATE,
LATER approval from the sibling
clinvar-2026-08-amendment-v2.pre_data_approval.draft.json, which gates
ONLY ClinVar archive acquisition (ADR-0020 stages 1-2) and does not
require or reference this file or its x64_freeze block. See
docs/project/specs/clinvar-2026-08-prospective-amendment-v2.yaml
'scoring_stage_approval' and the raptor.eval.prospective_freeze module
docstring.
IMMUTABLE-INPUTS EVIDENCE (independent review finding #5): unlike
'x64_freeze' below, every 'immutable_inputs' entry the registration
spec declares (tsc2.yaml, ACMG criterion/strength policy, BIAS
strength ladder/lineage, masking/predictor-aggregation policy, ...) is
a plain repository-tracked config file, verifiable OFFLINE on any
host, with no x64/BIAS/Nirvana dependency -- so
'immutable_inputs_verified' below is recorded as a real, already-true
value with real evidence, not a pending placeholder like
'x64_freeze'. raptor.eval.prospective_freeze.validate_scoring_stage_
approval independently RECOMPUTES this claim from allowed_repo_root's
actual current bytes regardless; a stale or fabricated claim here
would still be rejected at validation time even though it happens to
be accurate as of this writing.
'first_scoring_execution_at' is NOT a field of this record: it is a
separate, immutable input the scoring runtime itself supplies to
validate_scoring_stage_approval/adjudicate_prospective_outcomes at
call time (independent review finding #3) -- this file has no place
to pre-declare it, and pre-declaring a value here would not bind
anything, since only the runtime-observed timestamp is ever checked.
The 'x64_freeze' block below is left as an explicit pending placeholder:
this execution-preparation session ran only in WSL2 (uname -m = aarch64;
python is /home/sdrona/raptor/bin/python, platform.machine() = aarch64),
not the ADR-0008-designated x86_64 worker, so
raptor.eval.prospective_freeze.assert_runtime_boundary rejects it by
construction and no BIAS/Nirvana identity was, or could be, truthfully
inspected here. Completing this record requires running
'python scripts/compute_adr0008_resource_manifest_sha256.py' on the real
ADR-0008 x64 worker per docs/ops/adr-0008-resource-manifest-digest.md and
recording its real output -- never fabricating or copying a digest from
another registration/run.
_schema_note: Once approved for real, 'schema' must be exactly 'raptor.eval.scoring_stage_approval.v1' and this record must be closed to exactly {schema, registration_id, decision, approver, approved_at, x64_freeze, immutable_inputs_verified} -- no other keys. 'decision' must then be exactly 'APPROVED_SCORING_STAGE' (the only other allowed value, 'REJECTED_SCORING_STAGE', is rejected distinctly and never authorizes stage 4).
_decision_note: Not APPROVED_SCORING_STAGE. Only @dronasrinivas may approve this, and only after 'x64_freeze.resource_manifest_sha256' below is replaced with the real digest computed on the ADR-0008 designated x64 worker -- never fabricated or copied from another run. raptor.eval.prospective_freeze.validate_scoring_stage_approval independently RECOMPUTES resource_manifest_sha256 (and, separately, immutable_inputs_verified) rather than trusting either claim, and independently OBSERVES worker/BIAS/Nirvana identity rather than trusting x64_freeze -- a merely well-formed (e.g. all-zero) placeholder or fabricated value can never pass either check. Approval must also strictly precede the immutable, mandatory 'first_scoring_execution_at' the scoring runtime later supplies.

_immutable_inputs_verification_evidence.method: WSL2 raptor venv, offline, no network/archive access: canonical_lf_sha256 recomputed directly from each file's current on-disk bytes (LF-normalized before hashing); git_blob_sha1 recomputed via the same canonical-LF 'blob <len>\0<content>' SHA-1 formula raptor.eval.prospective_freeze._git_blob_sha1 uses, then compared against each registration-spec immutable_inputs pin.
_immutable_inputs_verification_evidence.result: all 12 immutable_inputs entries matched their registration-spec pins exactly; 0 mismatches

x64_freeze._blocking_reason: This execution-preparation session ran only in WSL2 (uname -m = aarch64; python is /home/sdrona/raptor/bin/python, platform.machine() = aarch64). raptor.eval.prospective_freeze.assert_runtime_boundary requires worker_arch == 'x86_64', worker_designation == 'adr-0008-designated-x64-worker', a matching pinned bias_commit and nirvana_banner, and a real 64-hex resource_manifest_sha256. None of these can be truthfully produced on this host; Nirvana was not run and no BIAS/Nirvana identity was inspected here.
